Iron’s Spells and Spellbooks is a comprehensive magic mod designed to support a full playthrough. Players rely on scrolls, which are applied to spellbooks, to cast spells throughout their journey.
Note: There is another mod called T.O's Magic N’ Extras which alters certain mechanics in Iron’s Spells and Spellbooks. Some information may differ when both mods are installed.
How do I begin my journey with Iron’s?
Iron’s is simple to start, but it heavily depends on exploration and structure loot. Your first goal should be acquiring Arcane Essence through looting chests found in structures.
Once you obtain enough essence, it’s recommended to craft the Wandering Magician Armor, which is made by combining leather armor with Arcane Essence in a crafting grid.
Next, consider crafting the powerful Graybeard Staff, which boosts spell power and mana regeneration. You should also choose an early spellbook such as the Flimsy Journal or the Ironbound Tome.
How do I apply spells to my book?
Applying spells is straightforward once you understand the basics. Spellbooks have a limited number of spell slots, but spells can be added or removed freely.
To begin, craft an Inscription Table. When placed, it forms a 2×1×1 multiblock. Right–clicking the table while holding a spellbook allows you to manage its spell slots.

Right–click the Scroll Forge to open the GUI, insert paper, then add your Focus item and ink to generate a scroll. The School and rarity of the resulting spell depend on these components.
Each spell belongs to a specific School of Magic, and each school requires a different Focus item. For example, a Firebolt Scroll belongs to the Fire School and requires a fire-themed Focus.
How do I get or craft Focus items?

Eldritch spells require research. Players must collect Ancient Knowledge Fragments and craft Eldritch Manuscripts to unlock and learn Eldritch spells.
Ink crafting works similarly to potion brewing. You will need magical materials such as Amethyst, Gold, Copper, and Iron.
Start by crafting an Alchemist Cauldron and placing a campfire beneath it.
You can begin with Common Ink found in structures or dropped by magical mobs, or convert unwanted Common Spells into ink.
Fill the cauldron with water, throw Common Spells into it, and they have a 50% chance to convert into their corresponding ink. Collect Ink with glass bottles.
